assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The denied service is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring)
The denial reason was that precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated for continuous rhythm assessment to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and optimize rate control management
